item.title: President Lee and Four Key Leaders Agree: "National Assembly Should Devise Major Reform Plans for Election Management" (이 대통령-4부 요인 “국회서 선거 관리 대개혁 방안 마련하자”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and the four key leaders (National Assembly Speaker, Supreme Court Chief Justice, Constitutional Court President, and Prime Minister) have agreed to have the National Assembly come up with a major reform plan for election management capable of restoring public trust, in connection with the shortage of ballot papers that erupted during the June 3 local elections. (이재명 대통령과 4부 요인(국회의장·대법원장·헌법재판소장·국무총리)이 6·3 지방선거 과정에서 불거진 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 국민적 신뢰를 회복할 수 있는 수준의 선거관리 대개혁 방안을 국회에서 마련하기로 의견을 모았다.)

President Lee and the four key leaders made this decision during a closed-door meeting at the presidential office on the afternoon of the 8th, according to Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Lee Gyu-yeon. They characterized the ballot paper shortage as a serious infringement on voting rights and agreed that a thorough investigation into the cause and the establishment of measures to prevent recurrence must be carried out swiftly. (이 대통령과 4부 요인은 8일 오후 청와대에서 비공개로 회동해 이렇게 결정했다고 이규연 청와대 홍보수석이 전했다. 이들은 투표용지 부족 사태를 중대한 참정권 침해로 규정하면서 철저한 진상규명과 재발 방지 대책 수립이 신속하게 이뤄져야 한다는 데 뜻을 같이했다.)

A presidential office official said, "All participants agreed that related legislation is necessary, but they decided to discuss which parts need to be revised and how, centered on the National Assembly." He added, "Some participants suggested that the chairperson of the National Election Commission, a part-time position, should work on a full-time basis." The meeting was attended by President Lee, National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, Constitutional Court President Kim Sang-hwan, Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. It is unusual for the four key leaders to gather over a specific issue. (청와대 관계자는 “참석하신 분들 모두 관련 입법이 필요하다는 데 의견을 같이했지만, 어느 부분을 어떻게 고쳐야 하는지는 국회를 중심으로 논의하기로 했다”며 “(비상근직인) 선관위원장이 상시로 근무하는 것이 필요하다는 의견을 제시한 분들도 있었다”고 말했다. 이날 회동에는 이 대통령과 조정식 국회의장, 김상환 헌법재판소장, 조희대 대법원장, 김민석 국무총리 등이 참석했다. 특정 사안을 두고 4부 요인이 한데 모이는 것은 이례적인 일이다.)

In his opening remarks, President Lee said, "Today, the heads of independent constitutional institutions have all gathered. I hope we can first have an official discussion on how to handle this issue," adding, "In some form, we must take appropriate responsibility from the perspective of the people, and we should also discuss what possible alternatives and measures are available." National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik stated, "As both ruling and opposition parties have submitted requests for a parliamentary investigation, we will promptly push forward a parliamentary investigation at the National Assembly level to uncover the truth." (이 대통령은 머리발언에서 “오늘 독립된 헌법기관의 책임자들이 다 모였는데 우선은 이 문제를 어떻게 다뤄야 할지 공식적인 논의를 했으면 싶다”며 “어떤 형태로든 국민 시각에서 그에 합당한 책임을 져야 할 것 같고, 어떤 가능한 대안과 대책이 있는지도 함께 논의해야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 조정식 의장은 “여야 모두 국정조사 요구서를 제출하였으므로 지체 없이 국회 차원의 국정조사를 추진해 진상규명에 나서도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

On the same day, the Democratic Party of Korea submitted to the National Assembly a "Request for a Parliamentary Investigation into the Truth of the Ballot Paper Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections and for Election Management Reform" (initiated by Floor Leader Han Byung-do), which was signed by all its lawmakers. The People Power Party also submitted a separate request for a parliamentary investigation as a party position to the National Assembly. (이날 더불어민주당은 소속 의원 모두가 이름을 올린 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태의 진상규명 및 선거관리개혁을 위한 국정조사 요구서’(한병도 원내대표 대표발의)를 국회에 제출했다. 국민의힘도 이날 별도의 국정조사 요구서를 당론으로 국회에 냈다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Formalizes ‘August 17 National Convention’… ‘June 3 Responsibility Debate’ Heats Up (민주 ‘8·17 전대’ 공식화…‘6·3 책임론’ 신경전 가열)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea will hold its national convention on August 17 to elect its next party leader. With Prime Minister Kim Min-seok effectively announcing his candidacy, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and Representative Song Young-gil are also expected to run. (더불어민주당이 8월17일 다음 당대표를 뽑는 전당대회를 연다. 김민석 국무총리가 사실상 출마 의사를 밝힌 가운데, 정청래 대표와 송영길 의원 등도 출마할 것으로 예상된다.)

Secretary General Jo Seung-rae held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the 8th and stated, “The Supreme Council reached a consensus to hold the regular national party convention in August, specifically on the earliest possible date, August 17.” He added, “We will form a national convention preparation committee and an election management committee, and accept candidate registrations for party leader and supreme council members. If there are four or more party leader candidates, a preliminary primary will be held before the main primary, and the leader and supreme council members will be elected through regional primaries.” With the introduction of the one-person-one-vote system starting from this national convention, competition among candidates vying for party members’ support is expected to be fierce. <<> On the same day, there was a heated debate both inside and outside the party regarding responsibility for the June 3 local elections, which saw the Seoul mayoral seat lost to the People Power Party. <<> Supreme Council member Lee Un-ju announced on Facebook that day, “Facing the results of the June 3 local elections, I deeply feel heavy responsibility,” and stated she would step down from her position as supreme council member. Within the party, this is interpreted as a move to pressure Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. A first-term lawmaker said, “It seems like a resignation aimed at saying, ‘I take responsibility for the election, so I’m stepping down, and Jeong Cheong-rae should do the same,’ given Lee’s opposing stance to Representative Jeong.” Representative Yeom Tae-young also posted on Facebook, saying, “The June 3 local elections were essentially a bitter defeat for the Democratic Party,” and pressured Representative Jeong by adding, “I recall stepping down immediately along with all the leadership as a supreme council member after the crushing defeat in the 2021 by-elections.” In response to Representative Jeong’s announcement on the 5th to form a local election evaluation committee and publish a white paper on the local elections, South Jeolla Province Governor Kim Young-rok said on MBC radio that day, “Publishing a white paper could potentially serve as a means to deflect blame,” and sharply argued, “Representative Jeong Cheong-rae must take responsibility.” <<> Representative Jeong’s side strongly refuted the theory of leadership responsibility. Secretary General Jo Seung-rae said, “The disputes surrounding the election evaluation—these were also ongoing during the election process,” and added, “Objectively speaking, failing to unify diverse voices led to regrettable results that can be called a defeat.” Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon criticized Representative Song Young-gil for making comments during the election period that seemed to defend independent candidate Kim Gwan-young, who was expelled from the party and later elected as North Jeolla Province Governor, saying, “Representative Song’s words and actions during the election process were irresponsible remarks—aren’t they a serious violation of party discipline?” Representative Choi Min-hee also expressed discomfort with Lee Un-ju’s resignation as supreme council member, posting on Facebook, “Representative Lee Un-ju, doing this in the cold weather is inappropriate.” <<> Amid this, there were also concerns about an overheated national convention. Representative Park Ji-won said on Facebook, “The competition for party leadership in the Democratic Party is escalating excessively,” and urged, “If we fail to win the general election and regain power, we’re all done. We need to find a way to hold a quiet national convention.” Another senior lawmaker said in a phone call with The Hankyoreh, “I believe the Yoon Seok-yeol administration is also part of the cause of the defeat. The proposal of a special counsel law for the cancellation of a prosecution case before the local elections, and the emphasis on strengthening real estate regulations, had a decisive impact on the election,” adding, “Can the painful aspects of the election results be resolved by criticizing specific individuals within the party?” <<> Reporters: Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr, Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (조승래 사무총장은 8일 국회에서 기자간담회를 열어 “최고위원회에서 정기 전당원대회를 8월 중 하되 가장 이른 시일인 8월17일 진행하기로 공감대가 만들어졌다”고 밝혔다. 조 사무총장은 “전당대회준비위원회와 선거관리위원회가 구성되고 당대표 후보자와 최고위원 후보자에 대한 후보 등록을 받을 것”이라며 “당대표는 4인 이상일 경우 예비경선을 거쳐 본경선을 하고, 권역별 순회 경선을 통해 대표와 최고위원을 선출하기로 했다”고 했다. 이번 전당대회 경선부터 1인 1표제가 도입돼 당원들을 향한 후보들 간 경쟁은 치열할 것으로 전망된다.)

item.title: Election Commission: Ballot shortage may extend beyond 50 polling stations (선관위 “투표용지 부족 50곳보다 더 많을 수도”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission reported to the Reform Party on the 8th that the number of polling stations experiencing ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections could increase beyond the initial 50 locations. (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 투표소가 50곳에서 추가로 늘어날 가능성이 있다고 개혁신당에 8일 보고했다.)

Cheon Ha-ram, the floor leader of the Reform Party, held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day and stated, "I received a report from the Deputy Secretary-General of the National Election Commission that this ballot shortage occurred at 50 polling stations, and actual voters had to wait at 22 of those locations." He added, "The National Election Commission reported that this was based on data as of the 5th, and the number could increase further." The Election Commission had initially announced on the 3rd that 14 polling stations faced ballot shortages, then revised it to 50 on the 5th, and now indicates that this figure could also increase. (천하람 개혁신당 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “이번 투표용지 부족 사태가 50개 투표소에서 발생했고, 실제 투표자가 대기해서 투표해야 했던 곳은 22곳이었다고 중앙선관위 사무차장으로부터 보고받았다”며 “중앙선관위는 이것은 지난 5일 기준으로 파악된 것이고, 추후 더 늘어날 수 있다고 보고했다”고 말했다. 선관위는 지난 3일 투표용지 부족 문제가 발생한 투표소가 14곳이라고 발표했다가 이틀 뒤인 5일 50곳이라고 정정했는데 이 수치도 추가로 늘어날 가능성이 있다고 밝힌 것이다.)

According to the National Election Commission's report, a total of 67 polling stations nationwide had additional ballots sent due to concerns about shortages. Among these, actual shortages occurred at 50 polling stations. The 50 locations where ballot shortages occurred were distributed as follows: 33 in Seoul, 3 in Busan, 4 in Daegu, 6 in Incheon, 2 in Ulsan, and 2 in South Gyeongsang Province. The 22 polling stations where voter waiting occurred were located in Seoul's Songpa District (12), Gangnam District (4), Gwangjin District (2), Seocho District (1), and Incheon's Yeonsu District (3). (중앙선관위 보고 내용을 보면, 투표용지 부족이 우려돼 추가로 용지를 송부했던 투표소는 전국에 67곳이었다. 이 가운데 50곳에서 실제로 투표용지 부족이 발생했다. 투표용지 부족이 발생한 50곳은 서울 33곳, 부산 3곳, 대구 4곳, 인천 6곳, 울산 2곳, 경남 2곳이다. 대기가 발생한 투표소 22곳은 서울 송파(12곳)·강남(4곳)·광진(2곳)·서초(1곳), 인천 연수구(3곳)다.)

It has been determined that the National Election Commission only became aware of the ballot shortage situation after receiving a complaint call on election day at 4:25 PM from a voter at the 3rd polling station in Garak 2-dong, Songpa District, Seoul. This occurred after ballots had been sent to the 7th polling station in Jamsil 4-dong, Songpa District, around 2:20 PM the same day due to concerns about a shortage. The Reform Party is advocating for "selective re-elections" at the polling stations that experienced ballot shortages, and has announced it will file a "petition for partial invalidation of the Seoul district election" to pursue this. (중앙선관위는 투표용지 부족 사태를 선거 당일 오후 4시25분 서울 송파구 가락2동 제3투표소의 민원인 전화를 받고야 알게 된 것으로 파악됐다. 당시 오후 2시20분께 송파구 잠실4동 제7투표소에서 투표용지 부족이 우려돼 투표용지가 송부된 이후다. 개혁신당은 투표용지가 부족했던 투표소에서 ‘선별적 재선거’를 치를 것을 주장하며, 이를 위해 ‘서울 관내 선거 일부 무효 소청’을 제기하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Reporters: Lee Ji-eun, Jang Na-rae, Oh Yoon-ju jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 장나래 오윤주 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Thanks 2030 Generation for Voting Station Protests, Says "You Made Us Think"… Signals Reform of Election Commission (이 대통령, 개표소 시위 2030에 “고민하게 해줘 감사”…선관위 개혁 시사)
item.description:
On the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung expressed sympathy for the voices of young people in their 20s and 30s who staged "vote-counting station blockade protests" against the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections, saying, "I also reflect a lot on the fact that they raised a fundamental issue about the exercise of sovereignty in the Republic of Korea, a democratic republic." The President stressed a policy of strong reform for the National Election Commission (NEC), stating, "I think we need to come up with fundamental measures. We were too complacent." <<> Responding to a question from a foreign journalist at a press conference marking his first year in office held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guesthouse (Yeongbingwan) on the same day, President Lee said, "Even countries with lower levels of democratic development would find this unimaginable and shocking." He continued, "In the Republic of Korea, a democratic republic, for the government to bungle the exercise of voting rights so carelessly—in crude terms—and prevent people from exercising their sovereignty, that's not just about the number of votes or the outcome; it's a very serious issue in itself. I think we've become numbed. I also felt a sense of reflection, thinking, 'Isn't this a lack of sovereignty sensitivity?'" This appears to be an effort to soothe public sentiment by actively conveying empathy for the critical awareness of the young people who raised the ballot shortage issue. President Lee added, "To be honest, I also had the thought, 'It's just a dozen or so people who couldn't vote, so it won't affect the outcome.' But they said ballot papers were insufficient from 2 p.m., and we left it unattended. I thought it was so pathetic that it made me wonder, 'Did they do it on purpose?' but I didn't approach it as a structural problem." <<> At the vote-counting station set up at the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul, protests demanding a re-election have been ongoing for the fourth day since the 5th, centered around young people in their 20s and 30s. They are protesting against the "violation of suffrage rights" and "undermining of fairness," and are strongly drawing a line against intervention by political forces. <<> President Lee defined their outcry as different from an "election rigging theory." He said, "I think it's entirely different: using a demonstrably false claim to build a power base through incessant agitation and brainwashing for political purposes, versus asking, 'How can people be unable to vote? In South Korea?'" <<> The President then emphasized that he would seek fundamental measures using the young people's raising of the issue as an opportunity. President Lee stated, "The NEC is an independent agency under the Constitution, so it doesn't even undergo audits by the Board of Audit and Inspection. The executive branch can only allocate budgets and approve funding for hiring, but must never interfere with how it operates. That's why I thought, 'Could there be any criminal suspicion?' and felt we at least need to get to the bottom of it. We need to know whether it was intentional or whether there are fundamental and structural problems, don't we?" The previous day, President Lee had ordered the prosecution and police to form a joint investigation headquarters to uncover the truth behind the ballot paper shortage. <<> President Lee's high regard for the critical awareness of young people regarding the ballot shortage is also interpreted as a move conscious of the youth sentiment confirmed through the results of the local elections. This is seen as the reason behind President Lee repeatedly saying to the young protesters, "You are truly precious and admirable," and "I reflect on this." At the end of his related remarks, the President said once more, "We almost let this slide, but if we had, wouldn't such a thing have happened again? I am grateful to the young people who made us engage in fundamental reflection." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 8일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태에 항의해 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’를 벌이는 2030 청년들 목소리에 공감을 표하며 “민주공화국 대한민국에서 주권 행사에 대한 근본의 문제라고 제기한 것에 대해 저도 많이 반성한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “근본적인 대책을 강구해야겠다는 생각이다. 너무 안일했다”며 중앙선거관리위원회에 대한 고강도 개혁 방침을 부각했다.)

item.title: Ballot shortage polling stations double from 50 to 91 in three days... election commission's management failures 'escalating' (용지 부족 투표소 사흘 만에 50→91곳…선관위, 관리 부실 ‘점입가경’)
item.description:
The National Election Commission announced on the 8th that a total of 91 polling stations experienced ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections, and among them, 26 stations required voters to wait due to the shortage before casting their ballots. The commission initially reported 14 polling stations with insufficient ballots on the 3rd, then corrected this to 50 on the 5th, but within three days, the number of polling stations facing ballot shortages nearly doubled. (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 때 투표용지 부족 사태가 총 91개 투표소에서 발생했고, 이 가운데 투표자가 투표용지 부족 탓에 기다리다가 투표해야 했던 곳은 26곳이었다고 8일 밝혔다. 선관위는 지난 3일 투표용지가 모자랐던 투표소를 14곳으로 발표했다가 5일 50곳으로 정정했는데, 사흘 만에 투표용지 부족 투표소가 두배 가까이 늘어난 것이다.)

The locations where ballot shortages occurred included 42 in Seoul (including 20 polling stations in Songpa District), 23 in Gyeonggi Province, 11 in Incheon, 4 in Daegu, 3 in Busan, 2 in Ulsan, 1 in North Chungcheong Province, 1 in North Jeolla Province, 2 in South Jeolla Province, and 2 in South Gyeongsang Province. Among the 26 polling stations where waiting occurred, 22 were in Seoul (including 15 in Songpa District), with one each in Busan, Daegu, Incheon, and Gyeonggi Province. This suggests that the commission not only mismanaged ballot supplies but also failed to properly assess the situation afterward, with such evidence continuing to emerge. (투표용지 부족이 발생한 곳은 서울 송파구 투표소 20곳을 포함해 서울이 42곳, 경기 23곳, 인천 11곳, 대구 4곳, 부산 3곳, 울산 2곳, 충북 1곳, 전북 1곳, 전남 2곳, 경남 2곳이었다. 대기가 발생한 투표소 26곳은 송파구 15곳을 포함한 서울 22곳, 부산·대구·인천·경기 1곳씩이다. 선관위가 투표용지 관리 미흡은 물론 이후 사태 현황 파악도 제대로 못 했다는 정황이 계속해서 드러나고 있는 셈이다.)

In response, the National Election Commission stated, "We apologize for the delay in quickly and accurately grasping the situation," and added, "The fact-finding committee will investigate whether there are additional polling stations with ballot shortages." The commission announced that it will form and operate a 'Ballot Shortage Fact-Finding Committee' for ten days starting from the 10th. It was revealed that the commission only became aware of the ballot shortage at 4:25 PM on the 3rd, the election day, after receiving a call from a voter at the 3rd polling station in Garak 2-dong, Songpa District, Seoul. (이에 대해 중앙선관위는 “신속하고 정확한 현황 파악이 늦어진 점에 대해 사과한다”며 “투표용지 부족 투표소가 추가로 있는지 등은 진상규명위원회가 조사할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 중앙선관위는 오는 10일부터 열흘 간 ‘투표용지 부족사태 진상규명위원회’를 구성해 운영한다고 밝혔다. 중앙선관위는 투표용지 부족 사태를 지난 3일 선거 당일 오후 4시25분 서울 송파구 가락2동 제3투표소의 민원인 전화를 받고야 알게 된 것으로 파악됐다.)

Meanwhile, the North Chungcheong Provincial Election Commission belatedly issued an apology on the same day, stating, "At around 6:10 AM on the 3rd, we confirmed that the names of 1,295 voters were omitted from the electoral register placed at the Seonghwa Gaesin Jungnim-dong 5th polling station, and we replaced it with a complete electoral register 30 minutes later to proceed with voting. It is estimated that one or two individuals ultimately could not vote." (한편 충북도선관위는 이날 “지난 3일 아침 6시10분께 성화개신죽림동 5투표소에 비치된 선거인명부에서 유권자 1295명의 이름이 누락된 것을 확인하고, 30분 뒤 누락 없는 선거인 명부로 대체해 투표를 진행했다”며 “최종 1~2명 정도가 투표하지 못한 것으로 추정된다”고 뒤늦게 사과문을 냈다.)

By Jang Narae, Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Xi Jinping visits North Korea for first time in 7 years… “Strengthen diplomatic, legal, and military exchanges with North Korea” (시진핑 7년 만에 방북…“북한과 외교·법·군사 교류 강화”)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed to comprehensively strengthen strategic cooperation within a new international order during a summit held in Pyongyang on the 8th. (김정은 북한 국무위원장과 시진핑 중국 국가주석이 8일 평양에서 한 정상회담에서 새로운 국제질서 속에서 전략적 협력을 전면 강화하기로 했다.)

President Xi, visiting North Korea for the first time in seven years, said at a meeting with Chairman Kim held at the Kumsusan Guesthouse in Pyongyang that day, “We intend to maintain close strategic communication and continuously develop China-North Korea relations to a new level,” according to China’s state-run Xinhua News Agency. President Xi particularly emphasized, “We will strengthen the linkage of development strategies (between North Korea and China),” adding, “Taking the full reopening of border crossings, civil aviation flights, and international passenger train services as an opportunity, we should expand personnel exchanges and realize two-way exchanges.” This signals a comprehensive expansion of economic cooperation between North Korea and China. President Xi also highlighted strengthening military and diplomatic cooperation, stating, “We will strengthen exchanges in diplomatic, law enforcement, and military fields.” Chairman Kim responded, “We will make the development of North Korea-China relations the nation’s most important primary strategic project.” There was no mention of issues concerning the Korean Peninsula, such as North Korea’s denuclearization. <<> President Xi, accompanied by his wife Peng Liyuan, arrived in Pyongyang around noon that day, beginning a two-day state visit to North Korea. Chairman Kim Jong-un and his wife Ri Sol-ju greeted President Xi and his wife at the airport. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (7년 만에 방북한 시 주석은 이날 평양 금수산 영빈관에서 열린 김 위원장과의 회담에서 “긴밀한 전략적 소통을 유지하며 중-조(북-중) 관계를 지속적으로 새로운 수준으로 발전시키고자 한다”고 말했다고 중국 관영 신화통신이 보도했다. 시 주석은 특히 “(북-중) 발전 전략 연계를 강화하겠다”며 “국경 통상구의 전면 재개통과 민항 항공편, 국제 여객열차 운행 재개를 계기로 인적 교류를 확대하고 쌍방향 교류를 실현해야 한다”고 말했다. 북-중 간 전면적인 경제협력 확대를 예고한 것이다. 시 주석은 또 “외교, 법 집행, 군사 분야의 교류를 강화하겠다”며 군사·외교 협력 강화도 부각했다. 김 위원장도 “조-중 관계 발전을 국가의 가장 중대한 제1전략사업으로 삼을 것”이라고 답했다. 북한 비핵화 등 한반도 문제는 전혀 언급되지 않았다.)

item.title: Promoting a 'Multipolar' Order to Counter US Hegemony: North Korea-China Relations Upgraded to 'Strategic Partners' (미국 패권에 맞선 ‘다극화’ 추진…북-중 ‘전략적 동반자’로 격상)
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping, visiting North Korea for the first time in seven years, and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un agreed on the 8th at the Pyongyang summit to fully restore North Korea-China relations and elevate them to a new stage as 'strategic partners.' The two leaders decided to significantly strengthen economic exchanges between the two countries, including the full resumption of customs operations, and also hinted at the possibility of military cooperation. Any mention of 'denuclearization' was completely absent. (7년 만에 북한을 방문한 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 김정은 국무위원장이 8일 평양 정상회담에서 북-중 관계를 전면 복원하고 ‘전략적 동반자’라는 새로운 단계로 나아가기로 했다. 두 정상은 통관의 전면적 재개를 비롯해 양국의 경제 교류를 대폭 강화하고, 군사적 협력 가능성도 시사했다. ‘비핵화’ 언급은 완전히 사라졌다.)

China's state-run Xinhua News Agency reported that Chairman Kim Jong-un, during his summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the Kumsusan Guest House in Pyongyang, defined North Korea-China relations as "the most important and foremost strategic project of the state" and emphasized that "consolidating and developing DPRK-China (North Korea-China) friendship in the new era is the choice of the people and the demand of the times." Chairman Kim stated, "We will continue to uphold the One-China principle without change and firmly support China's policies and positions in safeguarding its core interests." This clearly expressed his intention to support China's stance on defending core interests, including the Taiwan issue. <<> President Xi also emphasized to Chairman Kim, "Through this visit, we aim to strengthen the top-level design and strategic guidance of DPRK-China (North Korea-China) relations in the new era, promoting the development of these relations with the times to achieve greater progress." The two leaders also presented four proposals: strengthening political trust through high-level exchanges, enhancing practical cooperation to improve people's welfare, deepening ties driven by friendly traditions, and reinforcing strategic cooperation. <<> A particularly notable part was when President Xi said, "We should expand personnel exchanges and realize two-way exchanges by taking the full reopening of border trade ports, the resumption of civil aviation routes, and the operation of international passenger trains as an opportunity." This signaled a comprehensive expansion of economic cooperation between the two countries, including the opening of the new Yalu River Bridge between North Korea's Sinuiju and China's Dandong, which has remained unopened for over a decade since its completion. President Xi also stated, "We will strengthen the alignment of development strategies between the two countries," which is interpreted as heralding an expansion of economic cooperation on a different scale from China's past aid to North Korea. <<> The two leaders also emphasized military and diplomatic cooperation. President Xi noted, "This year marks the 65th anniversary of the signing of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance," and said, "The two sides should strengthen exchanges in diplomacy, law enforcement, and the military, properly implement important consensus, and pool wisdom and strength for the development of DPRK-China relations." <<> Earlier, in a bylined article published on the front page of the North Korean Workers' Party newspaper Rodong Sinmun on this day of his visit, President Xi highlighted that North Korea and China "firmly support the defense of national sovereignty, security, and development interests, and must jointly uphold the post-war international order," emphasizing that the North Korea-China relationship is an important partnership operating at the level of the international order, transcending the Korean Peninsula and engaging with US-China competition and North Korea-China-Russia cooperation. President Xi stated, "We oppose hegemonism and power politics, and oppose all ambitions and schemes that seek the revival of militarism and threaten regional security and stability," adding, "Let us jointly promote the multipolarization of the world and economic globalization." The 'multipolarization of the world' mentioned by President Xi is China's foreign strategy challenging US hegemony. The phrase 'opposing the revival of militarism' is interpreted as a call to jointly oppose Japan's rearmament. <<> In the North Korea-China summit and President Xi's article, there was no mention whatsoever of North Korea's denuclearization, inter-Korean relations, or other Korean Peninsula issues. This contrasts with Xi's 2019 visit to North Korea, when he positively assessed North Korea-US dialogue in his article and mentioned the 'Korean Peninsula' six times. This can be seen as an indication that 'denuclearization' is no longer a priority in North Korea-China relations, effectively acquiescing to North Korea's demand for recognition as a nuclear-armed state. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, analyzed, "This is a signal that China's paradigm for approaching North Korea has completely shifted from a 'mediator for North Korea-US denuclearization' to a 'tightly knit strategic partner for structural checks on the US.'" <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee: minggu@hani.co.kr (중국 관영 신화통신은 이날 김정은 위원장이 평양 금수산 영빈관에서 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 정상회담을 하면서 북-중 관계를 “국가의 가장 중대한 제1전략사업”으로 규정하고 “새 시대 조-중(북한과 중국) 우호를 공고히 하고 발전시키는 것은 인민의 선택이자 시대의 요구”라고 강조했다고 보도했다. 김 위원장은 “앞으로도 변함없이 하나의 중국 원칙을 견지하고 중국이 핵심 이익을 수호하기 위해 취하는 정책과 입장을 확고히 지지할 것”이라고 말했다. 대만 문제를 비롯한 중국의 핵심 이익 수호 입장을 지지하겠다는 의사를 분명히 한 것이다.)

item.title: North Korean Media: "New Milestone in North Korea-China Strategic Relations… Satisfactory Consensus Reached" (북 매체 “북·중 전략적 관계 새 이정표…만족한 견해 일치”)
item.description:
The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 9th that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, and Chinese President Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China and President of the People's Republic of China, agreed at a summit in Pyongyang to develop bilateral relations into a strategic partnership and expand exchanges and cooperation in various fields. (김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장과 시진핑 중국공산당 중앙위원회 총서기 겸 국가주석이 평양에서 한 정상회담에서 양자가 전략적 관계로 발전하고, 각 분야별 교류와 협력을 확대하기로 했다고 조선중앙통신이 9일 보도했다.)

KCNA reported that at the meeting held the previous day at the Kumsusan Guest House, Chairman Kim stated, "The Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) will continue to uphold DPRK-China friendship as the most important and primary strategic task, and will make every effort to strengthen and develop bilateral relations into a model of relations between socialist countries, a special, genuine, and unshakable strategic relationship." (조선중앙통신은 전날 금수산영빈관에서 열린 회담에서 김 위원장이 “조선노동당과 조선민주주의인민공화국(북한) 정부는 앞으로도 조중(북중) 친선을 가장 중대한 제1의 전략적 사업으로 견지하고 두 나라 관계를 사회주의 국가 간 관계의 본보기로, 변색될 수 없는 특수하고 진실하며 공고한 전략적 관계로 강화 발전시키기 위해 모든 노력을 다할 것”이라고 말했다고 전했다.)

Regarding the Taiwan issue, Chairman Kim also said, "No matter how the situation changes, our party and government will fully support and endorse the policies and positions of the Chinese party and government aimed at safeguarding core interests based on the 'One China' principle." When a North Korea-China summit was held in Beijing last September to mark the 80th anniversary of China's Victory Day, North Korean media did not report any mention of the cross-strait issue. (김 위원장은 대만 문제에 대해서도 “정세가 어떻게 변하든 우리 당과 정부는 ‘하나의 중국’ 원칙에 입각해 핵심이익을 수호하기 위한 중국당과 정부의 정책과 입장을 전적으로 지지 성원할 것”이라고 했다. 지난해 9월 중국 전승절 80주년을 맞아 베이징에서 북-중 정상회담이 열렸을 당시엔 북한 매체들이 양안 문제에 대한 언급을 보도하지 않았다.)

KCNA stated that Chairman Kim and President Xi agreed to "further strengthen strategic communication through high-level exchanges between the two parties and two countries, expand and develop exchanges and cooperation in political, economic, cultural, and other fields, and open a new chapter in the development of DPRK-China relations." They also agreed to hold commemorative events to mark the 65th anniversary of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, scheduled for July 11. (통신은 김 위원장과 시 주석이 “두 당, 두 나라 사이의 고위급 래왕(왕래)을 통한 전략적 의사소통을 더욱 긴밀히 하고 정치, 경제, 문화 등 각 분야에서의 교류와 협력을 보다 확대 발전시켜 조중관계의 발전의 새로운 장”을 열기로 합의했다고 했다. 또 7월11일로 예정된 북중 우호협력조약 체결 65주년을 계기로 기념행사를 개최하기로 했다.)

KCNA also reported that "exchanges of views on international and regional issues took place" during the meeting, and that discussions were held on "strengthening strategic coordination and cooperation between the two parties and two countries amid the complex and multifaceted global political situation, firmly safeguarding the sovereignty, security, and development interests of both countries, and jointly maintaining peace and development in the region and the world." This appears to pertain to discussions on the Korean Peninsula and international affairs, and KCNA noted that "a satisfactory consensus was reached" between the two leaders. However, like the previous day's report from China's Xinhua News Agency, North Korean media did not mention denuclearization. (회담에서는 또 “국제 및 지역문제들에 대한 의견교환이 진행됐다”며 “복잡다단한 세계정치 정세 속에서 조중 두 당, 두 나라 사이의 전략적 조정과 협력을 강화하고 양국의 주권과 안전, 발전이익을 굳건히 고수하며 지역과 세계의 평화와 발전을 공동으로 수호”하는 문제에 대해 논의했다고 통신은 보도했다. 이는 한반도와 국제정세에 대한 논의로 보이며, 두 정상 사이엔 “만족한 견해일치가 이룩됐다”고 통신은 밝혔다. 다만 전날 중국 신화통신 보도와 마찬가지로 북 매체도 비핵화 관련 언급은 하지 않았다.)

Xinhua and other outlets reported that President Xi would strengthen exchanges with North Korea in areas such as diplomacy, law enforcement, and the military, but KCNA did not report these remarks either. (신화통신 등은 시 주석이 북한과 외교·법 집행·군대 등 분야의 교류를 강화할 것이라고 보도했지만, 조선중앙통신은 이런 발언도 보도하지 않았다.)

Furthermore, KCNA emphasized that this meeting served as "a historical occasion that clearly demonstrated the immutability of DPRK-China friendship, which has been continuously consolidated and developed through joint struggles for the socialist cause, and set a new milestone in the development of strategic cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries." (아울러 조선중앙통신은 이번 회담이 “사회주의 위업 수행을 위한 공동의 투쟁 속에서 끊임없이 공고 발전되어 온 조중친선의 불변성을 뚜렷이 과시하고 두 당, 두 나라 사이의 전략적 협조 관계 발전의 새로운 이정표를 세운 역사적인 계기”라고 강조했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "A re-election cannot be held unless there is a serious violation... Jang Dong-hyuk's path has failed" (오세훈 “중대 위법 아니면 재선거 못 해…장동혁 노선은 실패”)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon expressed a negative stance on the 're-election' for the June 3 local elections demanded by People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk and others, stating, "I understand the political engineering interests, but the law stipulates that a re-election cannot be held unless there is a serious procedural flaw that could alter the outcome." (오세훈 서울시장이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표 등이 요구 중인 6·3 지방선거 ‘재선거’에 대해 “정치공학적인 이해관계는 이해하지만, 절차상 하자가 당락을 바꿀 만한 중대한 위법이 아니면 재선거는 치를 수 없도록 돼 있다”며 부정적 입장을 밝혔다.)

Mayor Oh made these remarks in an interview with the 'Chosun Ilbo' published on the 9th. Regarding the shortage of ballot papers that sparked the demand for a re-election, he said, "It is an absolutely unacceptable situation. I said in a recent public address that 'all powerful measures that the public can accept must be mobilized to uncover the truth,'" but added, "However, as the head of the Seoul Metropolitan Government's administration, I cannot add anything beyond that statement." (오 시장은 9일 공개된 ‘조선일보’와의 인터뷰에서 이같이 밝혔다. 오 시장은 재선거 요구의 원인이 된 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 “도저히 있을 수 없는 일이다. 얼마 전 대시민 담화에서 ‘국민이 납득할 수 있는 모든 강력한 수단을 동원해 진상을 규명해야 한다’고 밝혔다”면서도 “다만 서울시 행정 책임자로서 담화문 이상의 말을 보탤 수 없다”고 했다.)

On the demand for a 're-election,' he drew a line, saying, "I believe there are some politicians who want the Seoul mayoral re-election to happen again," adding, "I fully understand the political engineering interests, but the Public Official Election Act strictly stipulates that a full re-election cannot be held unless a procedural flaw in the election administration is a serious violation that could change the outcome." Chairman Jang is calling for a nationwide re-election, including Seoul. (‘재선거’ 요구에 대해선 “서울시장 재선거가 다시 열리기를 원하는 정치인들도 일부 있을 것으로 본다”며 “정치공학적인 이해관계는 충분히 이해하지만, 공직선거법에는 선거 행정 절차상의 하자가 당락을 바꿀 만한 중대한 위법이 아니라면 전면적인 재선거는 치를 수 없도록 엄격하게 명시돼 있다”며 선을 그었다. 장 대표는 서울을 포함한 전국 단위의 재선거 실시를 촉구 중이다.)

Regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, Mayor Oh claimed, "It means that the path Chairman Jang advocates has failed." He continued, "Now, the People Power Party is at a crossroads: either advance into the rough sea of the center or degenerate into a 'YouTube party' that only scratches where the hardcore supporters itch," adding, "It is now time for PPP lawmakers to decide whether they will fight next year's general election on this current path." item.title: President Lee Departs for G7 Summit... Interest in Whether He Will Meet Trump on 16-17 (이 대통령, G7 정상회의 위해 출국…16~17일 트럼프 만날지 관심)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung departed on the 9th to attend the Group of Seven (G7) summit and other engagements. (이재명 대통령이 9일 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 등을 위해 출국했다.)

The President departed around 9 a.m. from Seoul Airport in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, aboard the presidential jet, heading to Brussels, Belgium. At the airport, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung, Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, and Senior Political Secretary Hong Ik-pyo were present to see him off. Party leadership, including Democratic Party of Korea leader Jeong Cheong-rae, did not attend the send-off event. This is unusual, as party leaders typically personally escort the president when he departs on overseas trips. <<> The presidential office stated, "Given the prolonged Middle East war and domestic situations such as the mismanagement of the election commission, we minimized the number of send-off attendees, including personnel from the presidential office and the cabinet." <<> From today through the 18th, President Lee will visit Belgium, Italy, the Vatican, and France. According to the presidential office, this aims to expand Korea's diplomatic horizons into Europe, engage in major international issues, and establish its status as a globally responsible nation. <<> For his first schedule, the President will arrive in Brussels, Belgium, this evening (local time) and hold a dinner meeting with compatriots. The next day, he will hold a summit with Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever and, in the afternoon, meet with King Philippe. He will then hold summits with European Council President António Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. <<> On the 10th, President Lee will move to Rome, and the following day, the 11th, he will carry out a state visit schedule upon the invitation of Italian President Sergio Mattarella. This is President Lee's first visit to Italy since his inauguration. During the Italy visit, summits are scheduled with President Mattarella and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, and a 'Korea-Italy Business Round Table' will seek to boost bilateral corporate exchanges. <<> Following the state visit custom of visiting provincial cities, President Lee will travel to Florence to meet with the mayor and discuss ways to strengthen cultural cooperation. After completing the state visit schedule, the President plans to visit the Vatican on the 14th and 15th. On the 14th, he will attend a special Mass for peace and solidarity at St. Paul's Basilica, and on the 15th, meet with Pope Leo XIV and Cardinal Secretary of State Pietro Carolin. National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing on the 5th, "Through the special Mass, the President's speech will express Korea's will for global peace and solidarity amid rapidly changing international circumstances and seek support from the Vatican." <<> As his final schedule, President Lee will attend the Group of Seven summit held in Évian, France, on the 16th and 17th. The presidential office stated that attending the summit for the second consecutive year is expected to solidify its status as a G7-plus global responsible power. As U.S. President Donald Trump will also attend the summit, there is interest in whether a Korea-U.S. summit will be arranged. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 오전 9시께 경기 성남시 서울공항에서 대통령 전용기를 타고 벨기에 브뤼셀로 출발했다. 공항에는 김민석 국무총리와 윤호중 행정안전부 장관, 강훈식 대통령 비서실장, 홍익표 정무수석 등이 배웅을 나왔다. 정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 등 당 지도부는 환송 행사에 나오지 않았다. 통상 당 대표가 대통령 순방 출국 시 직접 배웅을 해왔던 것을 고려하면 이례적인 장면이다. )

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Will discuss proposing 'Special Election Act'... Early voting must be eliminated" (장동혁 “‘재선거 특별법’ 발의 논의하겠다…사전투표 없애야”)
item.description:
People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 9th regarding the shortage of ballot papers that occurred during the 6·3 local elections, "We will promptly initiate internal party discussions to propose a special act for conducting a re-election." He also argued, "We must expedite the revision of the election law so that re-elections can be conducted without early voting." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 9일 6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “재선거 실시를 위한 특별법을 발의할 수 있도록 신속하게 당내 논의를 진행하겠다”고 했다. 아울러 “재선거부터 사전투표 없이 실시할 수 있도록 선거법 개정 작업을 서둘러야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Holding a press conference at the National Assembly that morning, Director Jang said, "The fundamental solution to this disenfranchisement incident is ultimately a nationwide re-election. Even what has been revealed so far constitutes sufficient grounds for a re-election." (장 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “이번 참정권 박탈 사태를 근본적으로 해결하는 것은 결국 전국 재선거밖에 없다”며 “지금 드러난 것만 하더라도 충분히 재선거 사유가 된다”고 말했다.)

Director Jang continued, "We will promptly hold internal discussions to propose a special act for conducting a re-election," and emphasized, "We must extend the main voting date and absolutely eliminate early voting. The revision of the election law should be expedited so that re-elections can be conducted without early voting." Director Jang also said, "Let's meet with Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae even today and start discussions on pursuing a special counsel law. Only if we entrust this to a special counsel recommended by the People Power Party can the public trust the results." (장 대표는 이어 “재선거 실시를 위한 특별법을 발의할 수 있도록 신속하게 당내 논의를 진행하겠다”며 “본투표 날짜를 늘리고 사전투표는 반드시 없애야 한다. 재선거부터 사전투표 없이 실시할 수 있도록 선거법 개정 작업을 서둘러야 할 것”이라고 강조했다. 장 대표는 또 “정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 오늘이라도 당장 만나서 특검법 추진부터 논의하자”라며 “국민의힘이 추천하는 특검에게 맡겨야 국민도 그 결과를 신뢰할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the criticism that the re-election is interpreted as a demand for the resignation of Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, he refuted, "Our position is that local elections virtually need to be held again nationwide. It is inappropriate to mention only one specific candidate and ask if this is pressure for that candidate's resignation when we are talking about principles." (재선거가 오세훈 서울시장 사퇴 요구로 해석된다는 지적엔 “전국에 걸쳐서 지선을 사실상 다시 실시해야 한단 입장”이라며 “원칙을 이야기하는 데 특정 후보 1명만을 거론하면서 특정 후보에 대한 사퇴 압박이냐고 묻는 것은 온당치 않다”고 반박했다.)

item.title: "Ballot shortage also anticipated in Gangnam"… Election Commission says "Contact us when 500 remain" instead of replenishing (강남서도 “투표지 부족 예상”…선관위, 보충 대신 “500매 남으면 연락하라”)
item.description:
On election day, not only in Songpa-gu, Seoul, but also in Gangnam-gu, concerns about a ballot shortage were reportedly conveyed to the Election Commission from the morning, but the Commission did not take immediate replenishment measures. (선거 당일 서울 송파구뿐 아니라 강남구에서도 오전부터 투표용지 부족 우려가 선거관리위원회에 전달됐지만, 선관위가 즉각적인 보충 조처에 나서지 않은 것으로 나타났다.)

According to a summary from a Gangnam-gu official on the 9th, at around 11:33 a.m. on the 3rd, the day of the local elections, a report was sent to the Gangnam-gu Election Commission from the 4th polling station in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam-gu, stating, "It seems ballots will be insufficient." However, it was confirmed that the Gangnam-gu Election Commission instructed them to "contact us again when about 500 ballots remain." (9일 강남구 관계자 설명을 종합하면, 지방선거 본투표일인 지난 3일 오전 11시33분께 강남구 청담동 제4투표소에서 “투표용지가 부족할 것 같다”는 취지의 보고가 강남구 선관위에 전달됐다. 그러나 강남구 선관위는 “500매 정도 남았을 때 다시 연락해달라”고 안내한 것으로 파악됐다.)

A Gangnam-gu official said, "I understand that around 11:33 a.m., although ballots were still remaining, they reported that they might be insufficient," adding, "I heard that the Election Commission, likely having its own standards, asked them to contact again when about 500 ballots were left." (강남구 관계자는 “오전 11시33분 정도에 투표용지가 아직 남아 있기는 했지만 부족할 것 같다고 보고한 것으로 안다”며 “선관위에서도 기준 같은 게 있으니 500매 정도 됐을 때 다시 연락을 달라고 한 것으로 들었다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, in Songpa-gu, Seoul, concerns about a ballot shortage were raised around 11 a.m. on the same day, but after the Election Commission told them to "wait until 100 ballots remain," the ballots were actually exhausted, leading to complaints from voters. This means that different replenishment standards—'100' in Songpa-gu and '500' in Gangnam-gu—were applied, raising criticism that the on-site response criteria were unclear. (앞서 서울 송파구에서도 같은 날 오전 11시께 투표용지 부족 우려가 제기됐지만, 선관위가 “100매가 남을 때까지 기다리라”고 한 뒤 실제 용지가 소진돼 유권자들이 항의하는 일이 벌어졌다. 송파구와 강남구에서 각각 ‘100매’와 ‘500매’라는 서로 다른 추가 공급 기준이 적용된 셈이어서, 현장 대응 기준이 명확하지 않았다는 지적이 나온다.)

It was also reported that voting at the relevant polling station in Gangnam-gu ended past the 6 p.m. closing time. A Gangnam-gu official said, "There were a few people with waiting tickets," adding, "It wasn't many, but they finished voting around 6:10 p.m." (강남구의 해당 투표소도 투표 마감 시각인 오후 6시를 넘겨 투표가 끝난 것으로 전해졌다. 강남구 관계자는 “대기표를 받은 분들이 조금 있었다”며 “많지는 않았지만 그분들이 투표를 하느라 오후 6시10분께 끝났다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the ballot shortage incident, the Election Commission has stated that it will investigate the situation through a fact-finding committee. It is also known that the police are reviewing messenger conversations among election officials in areas that experienced ballot shortages and the details of ballot supply. (선관위는 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 진상규명위원회를 통해 당시 상황을 조사하겠다는 입장이다. 경찰도 당시 투표용지가 부족했던 지역의 선거 담당자들이 나눈 메신저 대화와 투표용지 공급 경위 등을 들여다보고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok: "Jang Dong-hyuk's People Power Party Has Merged with Hwang Kyo-ahn's Party... It Has Become the 'Yoon Again' Party" (이준석 “장동혁의 국힘, 황교안당과 일체화…윤어게인 정당 돼”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, criticized People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 9th for his push to abolish early voting, stating, "As of today, the People Power Party has become the 'Yoon Again' Party." (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 9일 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 사전투표제 폐지 주장에 대해 “오늘부로 국민의힘은 윤어게인 정당이 됐다”고 비판했다.)

Posting on his Facebook page that day, he said, "The People Power Party has effectively declared a merger with the Liberty and Innovation Party of former Prime Minister Hwang Kyo-ahn, which is a single-issue party fixated on election fraud, and has also declared unification with former President Yoon Seok-youl, who sent the military to the National Election Commission in a state of delusion." He added, "Thirsty leader Jang Dong-hyuk has taken a refreshing gulp of seawater, and now he will have no choice but to keep drinking to quench his thirst." (그는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “국민의힘은 사실상 부정선거 단일의제 정당인 황교안 전 총리의 자유와혁신과 일체화를 선언하고, 망상에 빠져 선관위로 군대를 보낸 윤석열 전 대통령과의 일체화를 선언한 것”이라며 “목마른 장동혁 대표가 시원하게 들이킨 바닷물 한 컵, 이제 갈증을 해소하기 위해 계속 들이킬 수 밖에 없을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Earlier that day, Jang held a press conference at the National Assembly regarding the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, announcing his intention to pursue a "special law for holding by-elections" while stating, "We should revise the election law to abolish early voting starting from by-elections." (앞서, 장 대표는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 ‘재선거 실시 특별법’ 추진 뜻을 밝히면서 “재선거부터 사전투표를 폐지하도록 선거법을 개정해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Regarding this, Lee pointed out, "Early voting was introduced as a replacement for absentee voting, which had a cumbersome reporting process, and it is the last safeguard to protect the vote of the younger generation, who cannot easily relocate due to short-term work or studies." He added, "It is a case of the pot calling the kettle black to condemn a situation where citizens were unable to cast their votes due to a shortage of ballot papers, while proposing a solution that blocks the very path for citizens to exercise their vote." He further challenged Jang, saying, "If you really want to abolish it, boldly propose a bill and hold a public hearing to prove that the conspiracy theory that early voting is a channel for election fraud is false, and demonstrate that the People Power Party is not a party swayed by such conspiracy theories." (이 대표는 이를 두고 “사전투표는 신고 절차가 번거롭던 부재자투표를 대신해 도입된 제도로, 단기 근무와 학업 때문에 주소지를 쉽게 옮기지 못하는 젊은 세대에게는 한 표를 지켜주는 마지막 장치”라며 “투표용지가 부족해 국민이 한 표를 행사하지 못한 사태를 규탄하면서, 그 해법으로 국민이 한 표를 행사할 길을 막겠다고 하는 건 적반하장”이라고 지적했다. 이어 장 대표를 향해 “정 폐지하고 싶다면 당당하게 법안을 발의하고 공청회를 열어 사전투표가 부정선거의 통로라는 음모론이 아니라는 걸, 국민의힘이 음모론에 휘둘리는 정당이 아님을 입증하라”고 했다.)

item.title: Kwon Young-se: "We need to discuss Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation... Nationwide re-election is inappropriate" (권영세 “장동혁 대표 사퇴 논의해야…전면적 재선거는 부적절”)
item.description:
Kwon Young-se, a five-term lawmaker of the People Power Party (PPP), stated that there is a need to discuss the resignation of PPP Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk. (국민의힘 5선 중진인 권영세 의원이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 사퇴에 대해 논의할 필요가 있다고 밝혔다.)

Appearing on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show" on the 9th, Kwon said, "This election is one we lost," adding, "We need to continuously discuss what measures are necessary for our party to avoid losing further, including whether the leadership might step down, not necessarily immediately, but as part of the discussions." He emphasized, "It's not about whether the leadership resigns right away, but we need to keep talking about what actions, including leadership stepping down, are needed." <<> When asked by the host, "Does Chairman Jang have to resign?" item.description:
As President Lee Jae-myung departed for a European tour on the 9th to attend the Group of Seven (G7) summit and other events, the absence of senior leadership from the Democratic Party of Korea, including Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae, during the send-off has drawn attention to the circumstances. <<> President Lee departed around 9 a.m. from Seoul Air Base in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, aboard the presidential jet for Brussels, Belgium. While several officials from the presidential office and government attended the farewell ceremony, the Democratic Party leadership was absent. item.title: China's 'Resist America, Aid Korea' Phrase Appears on Korean War Educational Poster… War Memorial Removes It Amid Controversy (6·25 교육 포스터에 중국 시각 ‘항미원조’ 표현…전쟁기념관, 논란 되자 삭제)
item.description:
A controversy has arisen after the War Memorial of Korea, located in Yongsan, Seoul and operated by the Korea War Memorial Foundation, used China's term 'Resist America, Aid Korea' in promotional materials for an educational program interpreting the Korean War. (서울 용산 전쟁기념관을 운영하는 전쟁기념사업회가 준비하는 한국전쟁 해설 교육 프로그램 홍보에 중국이 사용하는 ‘항미원조’ 표현이 들어가 논란이 일고 있다.)

Starting last month on the 30th, the Foundation posted a notice on its website inviting participants for an educational event titled 'The Korean War, Different Interpretations' (Two Perspectives Gazing at the Yalu River), held in commemoration of the Patriots and Veterans Day. (전쟁기념사업회는 지난달 30일부터 누리집을 통해 호국보훈의 날 기념으로 ‘6·25 전쟁, 서로 다른 해석’(압록강을 바라보는 두 시선)이라는 주제의 교육을 진행한다고 공지하고 참가 신청을 받고 있다.)

The target audience ranges from fourth-grade elementary students to adults. The sessions, each lasting 50 minutes, will be conducted by instructors from the Foundation's commentary team in the museum's exhibition halls on the morning of the 13th and the afternoon of the 25th. (초등학교 4학년 이상부터 성인이 교육 대상이다. 전쟁기념사업회 해설팀 강사가 교육하며 오는 13일 오전과 25일 오후 각각 50분씩 전쟁기념관 전시실에서 진행된다.)

In the program overview, the Foundation explained, 'By comparing the perspectives of South Korea and China on the Korean War, participants can understand the war from diverse viewpoints.' The promotional poster features two boys, presumably representing South Korean and Chinese nationalities. Above the South Korean boy are the Taegeukgi and the phrase '6·25 War,' while above the Chinese boy are the phrase 'Resist America, Aid Korea' and the Chinese flag. China refers to the Korean War as the 'War to Resist America and Aid Korea,' viewing it as a conflict where they fought against imperialist America to assist Joseon (North Korea). (사업회는 해설 개요를 통해 “6·25 전쟁을 바라보는 한국과 중국의 시각을 비교하면서 6·25 전쟁을 다양한 시각에서 이해할 수 있다”고 설명했다. 행사 안내 포스터에는 한국과 중국 국적으로 보이는 두 소년이 서 있는 모습이 담겼다. 한국 소년 위에는 태극기와 6·25전쟁, 중국 소년 위에는 항미원조와 중국 국기가 그려져 있다. 중국은 한국전쟁을 항미원조전쟁으로 부르고 자신들이 제국주의 미국과 맞서 싸우며 조선(북한)을 도운 전쟁으로 본다.)

Once the poster and the educational notice were released, criticism emerged questioning whether it was appropriate to educate South Koreans, including elementary school students, using China's perspective of 'Resist America, Aid Korea.' Amid the controversy, the Foundation removed the poster around 10 a.m. on the same day. (교육 공지가 포스터와 함께 나가자 이런 항미원조란 중국 쪽 시각을 초등학생을 포함한 한국인에게 교육하는게 맞느냐는 지적이 나왔다. 논란이 되자 기념사업회는 이날 오전 10시쯤 해당 포스터를 삭제했다.)

In response, a representative from the Korea War Memorial Foundation explained, 'This educational program aims to correct China's erroneous claims based on historical facts.' (이에 대해 전쟁기념사업회 관계자는 “해당 교육은 역사적 사실에 기반해 중국의 잘못된 주장을 바로잡는 내용”이라고 해명했다.)

The Korean War is referred to by various names domestically and internationally. Typically, war names are determined after the conflict ends, based on the victors or agreements among the parties involved. In cases like the Korean War, which ended in an armistice without a clear victor, differing names emerge as each party seeks to remember the war in its own way. (국내외에서 한국전쟁은 다양한 이름으로 불린다. 대개 전쟁 이름은 전쟁이 끝난 뒤 전쟁에서 이긴 나라 또는 전쟁 당사자들 간의 합의에 따라 확정된다. 한국전쟁처럼 승자 없이 휴전된 경우, 각자 방식대로 전쟁을 기억하려는 당사자들이 주장하는 다양한 이름들이 등장한다.)

In South Korea, it is called the 'June 25 Incident,' 'June 25 Disturbance,' 'Korean Disturbance,' 'June 25 War,' and 'Korean War.' The official term used by the government is the 'June 25 War,' emphasizing that the war began on June 25, 1950, with a surprise attack by North Korea, focusing on the initiator and responsibility for the outbreak. (국내에서는 6·25사변, 6·25동란, 한국동란, 6·25전쟁, 한국전쟁 등으로 부른다. 정부가 사용하는 공식 용어는 ‘6·25전쟁’이다. 1950년 6월25일 북한의 기습공격으로 한국전쟁이 발발됐다는 사실을 강조한다. 공격 주체, 전쟁 개시 책임에 초점이 맞춰졌다.)

North Korea calls it the 'Fatherland Liberation War.' It designates July 27, 1953, the date of the armistice agreement, as 'Victory Day,' celebrating the 'victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.' North Korea downplays its responsibility for starting the war and instead highlights July 27 as a triumph over the United States. China marks October 25 as the anniversary of 'Resist America, Aid Korea,' which commemorates the day in 1950 when the Chinese People's Volunteer Army crossed the Yalu River and first engaged South Korean forces at Onjeong-ri in Unsan County, North Pyongan Province. Although China claims the Korean War was fundamentally a war where they fought against the United States, many major battles at the regiment level and above during the three-year war took place between South Korean and Chinese forces. (북한은 ‘조국해방전쟁’이라고 한다. 북한은 한국전쟁 정전협정이 체결된 1953년 7월27일을 ‘조국해방전쟁 승리’를 기념하는 ‘전승절’이라 부른다. 북한은 전쟁 개시 책임은 눈감고 미국과의 전쟁에서 승리했다며 7월27일을 강조해 왔다. 중국이 항미원조 기념일로 삼는 10월25일은 1950년 압록강을 넘어온 중국인민지원군이 평안북도 운산군 온정리에서 국군과 처음으로 교전한 날이다. 중국은 한국전쟁의 기본 성격을 자신들이 미국과 맞서 싸운 전쟁으로 주장하지만, 한국전쟁 3년간 연대급 이상 주요 전투들은 상당수가 국군과 중국군 사이에서 벌어졌다.)

In Japan, it is called the 'Joseon War' (Korean War), while in the United States and Europe, it is known as the 'Korean War,' 'Korean Conflict,' 'Korean Civil War,' 'limited war' (in the U.S.), and 'forgotten war' (also in the U.S.), among others. (일본에서는 조선전쟁(朝鮮戰爭), 미국과 유럽에서는 Korean War, Korean Conflict, Korean Civil War, 제한전쟁(limited war, 미국), 잊힌 전쟁(forgotten war, 미국) 등으로 불린다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Min-seok: "The Ballot Shortage... We Must Take Young People's Concerns Seriously" (김민석 총리 “투표지 부족사태…청년들 문제의식 무겁게 받아들여야”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 9th, "The right to vote is the foundation of democracy," adding, "The National Assembly, political circles, and relevant agencies should take the concerns of young people seriously." (김민석 국무총리가 9일 “참정권은 민주주의의 근간”이라며 “국회와 정치권, 관계기관이 청년들의 문제의식을 무겁게 받아들일 것”이라고 말했다.)

In his opening remarks at a meeting of ministers on youth policy held at the Seoul Government Complex, Prime Minister Kim said, "I hope the entire government remains vigilant and responds to this issue (the ballot shortage)." ( 김 총리는 이날 정부서울청사에서 열린 청년정책 관계장관회의 모두발언에서 “정부 모두가 그 문제(투표지 부족사태)에 대해 경각심을 갖고 대처했으면 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. )

Referring to a meeting held on the 7th at the Seoul Government Complex with former and current student council presidents regarding the local elections, Prime Minister Kim said, "Right here, a few days ago, we held a meeting with college student representatives who had protested and expressed concerns about the ballot shortage. I felt ashamed. It was regrettable that we failed to think more sensitively, respond faster, and find solutions to such issues, and it has made me feel a greater sense of responsibility." ( 김 총리는 지난 7일 정부서울청사에서 개최한 ‘지방선거 관련 전·현직 총학생회 대표 간담회’를 언급하며 “바로 이 자리에서 며칠 전에 이번 투표지 부족문제와 관련해서 시위하고 또 걱정하는 대학생 대표들을 모시고 간담회를 했다. 부끄러웠다. 그런 문제에 대해서 저희가 더 민감하게 생각하고 더 빨리 대처해 해결책을 만들어내야 하는데 그러지 못한 상황이 안타까웠고 책임감을 더 가지게 됐다”고 말했다. )

Regarding the meeting's agenda items, such as improving systems to be family-friendly and measures for corporate support and job-linked assistance, Prime Minister Kim said, "We must explore various ways to overcome the situation where young people, when starting a family, face disadvantages in housing, finance, and taxation instead of receiving blessings." ( 김 총리는 이어 결혼친화형 제도개선, 기업지원·일자리연계형 지원 방안 등 회의 안건을 두고 “청년들이 가정을 꾸리면 축복이 아니라 오히려 주거·금융·세제에서 불이익을 받는 이 상황을 타개하기 위한 여러 방안을 모색해야 한다”고 했다. )

He also stated, "In a situation where youth unemployment and the recruitment difficulties of small and medium-sized enterprises coexist, strengthening incentives for companies that create jobs is very timely and important. Linking recruitment of young people to areas vulnerable to AI (Artificial Intelligence) transformation is also significant in terms of alleviating polarization between industries." ( 또한 “청년 취업난과 중소기업 구직난이 공존하는 상황에서 일자리를 창출하는 기업에 인센티브를 강화하는 방안은 매우 시의적절하고 중요하다”며 “에이아이(AI·인공지능) 전환 취약 부분에 청년 채용을 연계하는 것은 산업 간 양극화 완화 차원에서도 의미가 크다”고 했다. )

Additionally, Prime Minister Kim said, "Although young people who get injured or fall ill during their military service receive free treatment at military hospitals, sometimes they suffer aftereffects after discharge. It is necessary to expand injury insurance related to military service." ( 김 총리는 아울러 “청년들이 군대에서 다치거나 아픈 경우 군 병원에서 무료로 치료를 받기는 하는데, 제대 후에 후유증이 남는 경우도 있다”며 “군 복무 관련 상해보험을 확대할 필요가 있다”고 했다. )

item.title: Democratic Party: "Special Counsel for Manipulated Indictments and Supplementary Investigation Powers of Prosecutors to Be Discussed After Assembly Formation" (민주 “조작기소 특검·검찰 보완수사권, 원 구성 이후 논의”)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections concluded, attention in the Democratic Party is turning to the "Special Counsel Act on Manipulated Indictments," which was postponed after the elections, and the "Criminal Procedure Act Amendment," a follow-up measure to prosecutorial reform. The Democratic Party plans to first focus on a parliamentary investigation into the shortage of ballots for the local elections. Once the Judiciary Committee is formed in the latter half of the 22nd National Assembly, discussions on handling these bills are expected to commence. (6·3 지방선거가 끝나면서 더불어민주당이 선거 뒤로 미뤄 둔 ‘조작기소 특검법’과 검찰개혁 후속 조처인 ‘형사소송법 개정’ 처리에 관심이 쏠린다. 민주당은 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사에 먼저 집중하고, 22대 국회 후반기 법제사법위원회가 꾸려지면 해당 법안 처리 논의에 착수할 전망이다.)

A senior official from the Democratic Party's floor leadership said in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh* on the 9th, "Right after the local elections and given the urgent need for a parliamentary probe of the election commission, neither the Special Counsel Act on Manipulated Indictments nor the Criminal Procedure Act amendment has been discussed yet. Discussions involving the party, government, and presidential office are expected to begin around June when the Assembly forms its committees, centered on the Judiciary Committee." A multi-term Democratic Party lawmaker conveyed the internal sentiment, saying, "Even before the committee formation, if necessary, we could discuss it not just in standing committees but also at a general meeting of lawmakers. But it seems unlikely we will immediately discuss the Special Counsel Act or the Criminal Procedure Act amendment." The Democratic Party insists that the formation of 22nd National Assembly committees for the latter half must be completed by the 18th. However, if negotiations with the People Power Party drag on, the committee formation could slip into July. (민주당 원내 지도부 관계자는 9일 한겨레와의 통화에서 “지방선거 직후인 데다가 선관위 국정조사가 시급한 상황이라 조작기소 특검법이나 형사소송법 개정 모두 논의가 이뤄지지 않았다”라며 “6월 원 구성 이후 법제사법위원회 중심으로 당·정·청 협의 등이 이뤄질 것으로 보인다”라고 했다. 민주당 한 다선 의원은 “원 구성 이전이라도 필요하다면 상임위가 아니라 의원총회에서도 논의하겠지만 당장 조작기소 특검법이나 형사소송법 개정 논의를 할 것 같지는 않다”고 당내 기류를 전했다. 민주당은 22대 국회 후반기 원 구성을 오는 18일까지 마쳐야 한다는 입장인데, 국민의힘과 협상이 길어질 경우 원 구성은 7월로 넘어갈 수 있다.)

Within the party, President Yoon's remarks at his first-year anniversary press conference the previous day—where he said, "If there are any wrongful (prosecutorial) indictments, we can correct them; if there are none, we can leave them as is"—are seen as making the re-pursuit of the Special Counsel Act on Manipulated Indictments a predetermined course. A senior lawmaker said, "President Yoon is convinced that the prosecution's (alleged) manipulated indictments are certain, and that wrongful indictments must naturally be withdrawn." However, internal party discussions on granting the authority to withdraw indictments, as included in the special counsel bill, are expected to take place later. Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae stated at a press briefing the previous day regarding the special counsel bill, "We are considering everything, including the content and timing, with an open mind." (당내에서는 이 대통령이 전날 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “(검찰의 기소가) 잘못된 게 있으면 바로 잡으면 되는 거고 잘못된 게 없으면 놔두면 되는 것”이라고 공개 발언한 만큼 조작기소 특검법 재추진은 정해진 수순으로 보고 있다. 한 중진 의원은 “이 대통령은 (검찰이) 조작기소한 것이 확실하고 잘못된 기소는 당연히 취소해야 된다는 확신을 갖고 있다”고 했다. 다만 특검법안에 포함된 공소취소 권한 부여에 대한 당내 논의는 추후 이뤄질 것으로 예상된다. 조승래 민주당 사무총장은 전날 기자간담회에서 특검법과 관련해 “내용과 시기 등을 다 열어놓고 고민 중”이라고 밝혔다.)

Discussions on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which will determine whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, are also expected to accelerate after the committee formation. The Prosecutorial Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office aims to prepare multiple versions of the amendment addressing the existence of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers as early as this week. Subsequent consultations between the party and government are anticipated. (검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 결정할 형사소송법 개정안 논의도 원 구성 이후 속도를 낼 것으로 예상된다. 총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단은 이르면 이번 주 안에 검찰의 보완수사권 유무를 담은 형사소송법 개정안 복수안을 마련하는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 이후 당정 협의가 이뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

The previous day, President Yoon said at a press conference regarding whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, "I hope it will be handed over to the National Assembly for discussion, and the government will not insist on any particular position." President Yoon had previously maintained that the prosecution should retain supplementary investigation powers for exceptional cases, but his remarks that day are interpreted as a retreat from his earlier stance. A government official said, "After the government prepares multiple versions of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment and hands them over to the ruling party, there may be various ways to proceed with discussions thereafter. The president's remarks yesterday appear to indicate respect for the ruling party's opinion." (전날 이 대통령은 기자회견에서 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부에 대해 “국회로 넘겨 논의하고 정부 입장을 어느 쪽으로 고집하지 말면 좋겠다”고 한 바 있다. 이 대통령은 그간 예외적인 사안에 대해 검찰에 보완수사권을 부여해야 한다는 입장이었으나 이날 발언은 기존 입장에서 물러선 것으로 해석된다. 정부 관계자는 “정부가 형사소송법 개정안 복수안을 마련해 여당에 넘긴 뒤 그 이후에는 어떻게 논의할지 다양한 방식이 있을 텐데, 어제 대통령의 말은 여당 의견을 존중하겠다는 것으로 보인다”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jung Hye-min: jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Fans Conspiracy Theories by Claiming "Identical Vote Tallies at Two Advance Polling Stations" – Election Commission Refutes (장동혁 “사전투표 2곳 득표수 동일” 음모론에 장작 넣기…선관위 반박)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, raised an issue by claiming that in the advance voting results for the Incheon Mayor and the Gwangju-Jeonnam Integrated Special City Mayor elections, identical vote counts for candidates emerged in different regions, which the respective local election commissions refuted as a "coincidence." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 인천광역시장과 광주전남통합특별시장 선거 관내 사전투표 결과, 지역이 다른데 후보별 득표수가 같은 사례가 발생했다며 문제 삼자 해당 지역 선거관리위원회는 “우연의 일치”라며 반박했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on the 9th, Representative Jang stated, "In the advance voting for Songdo 1 and 2 neighborhoods in the Incheon mayoral election, the votes for People Power Party's Yoo Jeong-bok and Democratic Party's Park Chan-dae were completely identical, with a probability of 1 in 590 million," and "In the Gwangju-Jeonnam integrated mayoral election, there were as many as 10 regions where the vote counts for the two candidates were the same, meaning the probability of 1 in 590 million would need to be multiplied six times." (장 대표는 9일 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “인천시장 선거 송도 1·2동 관내 사전투표에서 국민의힘 유정복, 민주당 박찬대 후보 득표수가 완전히 일치했는데 그 확률이 5억9천만분의 1”이라며 “광주·전남 통합시장 선거에서는 두 후보의 투표수가 똑같은 지역이 무려 10곳이나 있었는데 그렇다면 확률적으로 5억9천만분의 1을 6번 곱해야 하는 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Representative Jang brought up this issue alongside the shortage of ballot papers, calling it "an even more unbelievable situation." He then called for nationwide re-elections and the introduction of a special counsel. (장 대표는 투표용지 부족 사태와 함께 이를 거론하며 “더 믿기 어려운 일”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 전국 단위의 재선거 실시와 함께 특검 도입을 촉구했다.)

The Incheon Metropolitan City Election Commission and the Jeonnam Election Commission each released statements on the same day, immediately refuting Representative Jang's claims. (인천광역시선거관리위원회와 전남선거관리위원회는 이날 각각 자료를 내어 장 대표의 주장을 즉각 반박했다.)

The Incheon Election Commission confirmed that, as Representative Jang stated, the advance voting results for Songdo 1 and Songdo 2 neighborhoods showed Democratic Party candidate Park Chan-dae receiving 3,030 votes in both locations, and People Power Party candidate Yoo Jeong-bok receiving 1,440 votes in both. However, the total number of voters differed between the two locations—4,548 and 4,540, respectively. The vote counts for Reform Party candidate Lee Gi-bung also differed between the two locations, with 61 and 47 votes. Invalid votes were 15 and 22, and abstentions were 2 and 1, also showing differences. (인천선관위는 장 대표 말대로 송도1동 사전투표와 송도2동 사전투표 결과 박찬대 더불어민주당 후보가 두 곳에서 모두 각각 3030표를 득표했고, 유정복 국민의힘 후보가 모두 1440표를 득표했다고 밝혔다. 그런데 전체 선거인 수는 두 곳이 각각 4548명과 4540명으로 차이가 있었다. 박 후보와 유 후보 외에 개혁신당 이기붕 후보의 득표수는 두 곳에서 각각 61표와 47표로 달랐다. 무효표는 15표와 22표, 기권은 2표와 1표로 역시 차이가 있었다.)

The Incheon Election Commission stated, "While it may be claimed that the identical advance voting results from Songdo 1 and Songdo 2 are manipulated, the detailed breakdown shows that the total number of voters and the remaining votes are all different," explaining that the matching figures were a "coincidental outcome." (인천선관위는 “송도1동과 송도2동의 관내 사전투표 결과가 일치해 조작된 것처럼 주장하지만, 상세 내역을 보면 전체 투표자 수와 나머지 표수는 모두 다르다”며 수치가 같은 부분은 “우연한 결과”라고 밝혔다.)

The explanation from the Jeonnam Election Commission was also that it was a "coincidental outcome." (전남선관위의 설명도 “우연한 결과”라는 것이었다.)

In Jeonnam's Geumsan-myeon, Democratic Party candidate Min Hyeong-bae received 1,401 votes, and People Power Party candidate Lee Jeong-hyeon received 120 votes, while in Gwangju's Gwangsan-gu Songjeong 1-dong, the counts were also identical at 1,401 and 120 votes. However, the total number of voters in the two locations differed—1,828 and 1,764—and vote counts for other candidates also varied. The same was true for other regions Representative Jang highlighted. (전남군 금산면에서 민형배 민주당 후보가 1401표, 이정현 국민의힘 후보가 120표를 었었고, 광주 광산구 송정1동에서도 각각 1401표와 120표로 수치가 같았다. 하지만 두 곳의 전체 선거인 수는 1828명과 1764명으로 달랐고, 두 후보를 제외한 나머지 후보들의 득표수도 모두 달랐다. 장 대표가 지적한 다른 지역의 결과도 마찬가지였다.)

The Jeonnam Election Commission added, "After the advance voting ended, the ballot boxes were sealed and locked under the observation of vote observers, escorted by vote observers and police to each district, city, or county election commission, and stored securely in locations with CCTV until election day. Then, after the voting closed on election day, they were transported to each counting station, where counting proceeded independently under the observation of party-recommended commissioners and counting observers," and "It is simply a coincidence that results tallied by different people in different locations matched by chance." (전남선관위는 “사전투표함은 사전투표 종료 뒤 투표참관인의 참관 아래 봉쇄·봉인되었으며, 투표참관인과 호송 경찰 등이 동반해 각 구·시·군선거관리위원회로 이송한 후 선거일까지 시시티브이(CCTV)가 설치된 장소에 안전하게 보관됐다. 이후 선거일 투표 마감 시각 후 정당 추천위원과 개표 참관인이 참관하는 가운데 각 개표소로 이송되어 독립적으로 개표가 진행됐다”며 “서로 다른 장소에서 서로 다른 사람들이 집계한 결과가 우연히 맞아떨어진 것뿐”이라고 덧붙였다.)

The Election Commission attached original vote-counting tables for each region and emphasized, "We urge refraining from raising and spreading baseless suspicions about voting results that were fairly tallied by different equipment and personnel, solely on the grounds of statistical improbability." (선관위는 지역별 개표 상황표 원본을 첨부하며 “확률적으로 희박하다는 이유만으로, 각기 다른 장비와 인력을 통해 공정하게 집계된 투표 결과에 대해 근거 없는 의혹을 제기하고 확산하는 행위를 자제해 주시기를 당부드린다”고 강조했다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Agree on National Assembly Investigation into Election Commission… But Differ on Police Dissolution Probe and Special Committee Formation (‘선관위 국정조사’ 여야 공감에도…경찰 해산 조사, 국조특위 구성엔 이견)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties have formed a consensus on pushing for a National Assembly investigation into the "June 3 local elections ballot shortage crisis," but they hold differing views on the scope of the probe and the formation of a special committee. (여야가 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태’에 대한 국회 국정조사 추진에 공감대를 형성했으나 조사 범위와 특별위원회 구성을 두고 이견을 보이고 있다.)

National Assembly Floor Leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, Han Byung-do, said at a party meeting on the 9th, "This incident is a disaster that has fatally undermined both South Korea's democracy and the right to vote," adding, "We will convene an immediate plenary session this week to report on the investigation plan. We will expedite a vote in next week's plenary session to launch the special committee as quickly as possible." People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also stated in a press conference at the National Assembly that "we must accelerate the pace of the investigation." (한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 9일 국회에서 열린 당 원내대책회의에서 “이번 사태는 대한민국 민주주의와 참정권 모두를 치명적으로 훼손한 참사”라며 “이번주에 즉각 본회의를 개최해 국정조사계획서를 보고하겠다. 다음주 본회의에서 곧장 의결해 최단시간 내에 특위를 가동하겠다”고 말했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 국회 기자회견에서 국정조사의 “추진 속도를 높여야 한다”고 말했다.)

According to the requests for a National Assembly investigation submitted separately by the ruling and opposition parties the previous day, their positions differ on the scope of the probe and the composition of the special committee. Both parties agree on investigating the circumstances and current status of the ballot shortage crisis, but the People Power Party insists that the probe should also include "matters related to the police mobile unit's suppression of civilian violence during protest demonstrations." Additionally, the Democratic Party argues that the special committee should be formed according to the party's seat ratio in the National Assembly (10 members for the Democratic Party, 6 for the People Power Party, and 2 for non-negotiating groups), while the People Power Party maintains that it should be composed equally with 9 members from each side. The People Power Party also insists that a member of their party should chair the special committee. Typically, the chairmanship of special committees alternates between the ruling and opposition parties, but the chair of the previous "Manipulated Indictment Special Committee" was held by a Democratic Party lawmaker. (전날 여야가 각각 국회에 제출한 국정조사요구서를 보면, 조사 범위와 국조특위 구성 등에서 입장이 갈린다. 투표용지 부족 사태의 발생 경위와 현황 등에 대한 조사에는 여야 모두 찬성하지만, 국민의힘은 항의 시위 과정에서 불거진 ‘경찰 기동대의 시민 폭력 진압 사태에 관한 사항’도 조사 범위에 담아야 한다고 했다. 또 민주당은 국회 의석 비율대로 국조특위 위원 정수(민주당 10명, 국민의힘 6명, 비교섭단체 2명)를 꾸려야 한다고 했고, 국민의힘은 여야 9 대 9 동수로 해야 한다는 입장이다. 국민의힘은 국조특위 위원장도 소속 의원이 맡아야 한다는 방침이다. 통상 특위 위원장은 여야가 번갈아 맡는데, 직전 ‘조작 기소 국조특위’ 위원장을 민주당 의원이 맡았다는 이유다.)

Amidst this, Floor Leader Han responded to People Power Party lawmaker Kim Jae-seop's demand from the previous day to "include President Lee and the Blue House in the investigation target," saying, "Is this about fundamentally solving the problem, or using this incident as material for your own political gain?" He added, "Stop this irresponsible political manipulation." (이런 가운데 한 원내대표는 전날 김재섭 국민의힘 의원이 “국정조사 대상에 이재명 대통령과 청와대를 포함하라”고 요구한 데 대해 “근본적인 문제를 해결하자는 거냐, 아니면 이번 사태를 자신들의 정치적 이익을 위한 소재로 활용하자는 거냐”며 “무책임한 선동 정치를 그만두라”고 반발했다.)

Meanwhile, the Central Election Commission's "Truth-Finding Committee on the Ballot Shortage Crisis" announced on this day that it plans to conduct a ten-day investigation starting from the 10th into the overall ballot shortage crisis that occurred during the main voting process of the June 3 local elections, covering areas such as ballot printing, allocation, and supply management. (한편 중앙선거관리위원회 ‘투표지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회’는 10일부터 열흘간 투표용지 인쇄와 배정, 수급 관리 등 6·3 지방선거 본투표 과정에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태 전반을 조사할 계획이라고 이날 밝혔다.)

Reporters Kim Chae-woon and Jang Na-rae cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 장나래 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Controversy over Jang Dong-hyuk’s Overreach: “Is Calling for a By-election Saying Oh Se-hoon Should Step Down?” (장동혁 무리수 논란…“재선거, 오세훈 그만두라는 얘기냐?”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, reiterated the need to hold nationwide by-elections for the June 3 local elections on the 9th, arguing that “we should expedite the revision of election laws to allow for by-elections to be conducted without early voting.” Critics are mounting that he is making an overreach by even bringing up the abolition of early voting, while the directly affected party, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, has already dismissed the idea of a by-election. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 9일 전국적인 6·3 지방선거 재선거 실시 필요성을 거듭 강조하면서 “재선거부터 사전투표 없이 실시할 수 있도록 선거법 개정 작업을 서둘러야 한다”고 주장했다. 당사자인 오세훈 서울시장도 재선거를 일축한 상황에서 사전투표 폐지론까지 끌어들이는 무리수를 두고 있다는 비판이 거세지고 있다.)

During a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Jang cited the ballot shortage incident, stating, “The fundamental solution to the deprivation of voting rights is a nationwide by-election,” and adding, “I will quickly proceed with internal party discussions to propose a special bill for holding nationwide by-elections.” (장 대표는 이날 국회 기자회견에서 투표용지 부족 사태를 언급하며 “참정권 박탈 사태의 근본 해결은 전국 재선거밖에 없다”며 “전국 재선거 실시를 위한 특별법을 발의할 수 있도록 신속하게 당내 논의를 진행하겠다”고 말했다.)

Jang further claimed, “In the Incheon mayoral election, the votes for candidate Yoo Jeong-bok and candidate Park Chan-dae were exactly identical in the early voting at Songdo 1-dong and Songdo 2-dong, which has a probability of 1 in 590 million,” and “In the South Jeolla-Gwangju integrated mayoral election, there were as many as 10 districts where the two candidates received the same number of votes—a probability that requires multiplying 1 in 590 million six times.” He then insisted, “We must extend the main voting days and definitely abolish early voting.” The Incheon and South Jeolla election commissions rebutted Jang’s claims, urging him to “refrain from raising baseless suspicions of election fraud simply because of probabilistically rare cases.” <<> Criticism also emerged from within the People Power Party itself, with some finding Jang’s arguments difficult to accept. <<> Mayor Oh Se-hoon immediately stated in an interview with the Chosun Ilbo published that day, “Unless a procedural flaw is a serious illegality that could alter the outcome, by-elections cannot be held.” Lawmaker Park Jeong-ha likewise said in an MBC radio interview, “What benefit would a by-election bring to our party? Isn’t that essentially telling Mayor Oh Se-hoon to step down?” Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok commented on the call to abolish early voting, saying, “As of today, the People Power Party has declared its unity with former President Yoon Suk-yeol, who, in a delusion, sent the military to the election commission, so it has become the ‘Yoon Again’ party.” <<> That day, calls for Jang to take responsibility for the election defeat continued. At a debate evaluating the local election results hosted by the party’s internal reform-oriented group “Alternatives and Future,” Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop stated, “Thanks to the tactic of ‘avoiding Chairman Jang,’ we won the Seoul mayoral election.” <<> By Jang Na-rae, staff reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 이어 “인천광역시장 선거 송도1동과 송도2동 관내 사전투표에서 유정복 후보와 박찬대 후보의 득표수가 완전히 일치했는데 그럴 확률이 5억9천만분의 1”이라며 “전남광주통합시장 선거에선 두 후보의 득표수가 똑같은 지역이 무려 10곳이나 있었다. 이는 5억9천만분의 1을 6번 곱해야 하는 확률”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 장 대표는 “본투표 날짜 늘리고 사전투표는 반드시 없애야 한다”고 주장했다. 인천과 전남선관위는 장 대표의 주장에 대해 “확률적으로 드문 사례라는 이유만으로 근거 없는 부정선거 의혹을 제기하는 행위를 자제해달라”고 반박했다.)
